messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot properly log claims or export audit logs, which disrupts daily operations and risks compliance deadlines. Without reliable tracking and reporting, teams face audits unprepared and lose trust in the system.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "5d34277f-8ec2-5892-b44d-efd7248786a5",
   "similarity": 0.079,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"5d34277f-8ec2-5892-b44d-efd7248786a5\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Reporting navigation\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Reporting navigation\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Users can navigate through reporting sections in Keelwater with a streamlined menu, allowing quick access to claims summaries, analytics, and export options without leaving the current context.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Users can navigate through reporting sections in Keelwater with a streamlined menu, allowing quick access to claims summaries, analytics, and export options without leaving the current context.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\":"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4131",
   "similarity": 0.054,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater's workspace administration feature allows users to manage permissions, configure settings, and organize teams within their claims environment — all through a centralized, intuitive dashboard.\", \"id\": 4131, \"name\": \"Workspace administration\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4128",
   "similarity": 0.053,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now allows users to filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries.\", \"id\": 4128, \"name\": \"Claim search refinements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4135",
   "similarity": 0.051,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's claim information display provides a clear, real-time overview of active claims, including status, assigned adjuster, and key dates, helping users stay informed without switching screens.\", \"id\": 4135, \"name\": \"Claim information display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4133",
   "similarity": 0.05,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's document classifier confidence threshold setting allows users to define the minimum confidence level required for automatic categorization of claims documents, ensuring only high-certainty classifications are applied without manual review.\", \"id\": 4133, \"name\": \"Document classifier confidence threshold\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem statement claims users cannot properly log claims or export audit logs, risking compliance failures. Checking the five most similar items: 'Reporting navigation' covers menu navigation, not claim logging or audit log export; 'Workspace administration' (completed) addresses permissions and settings, not this problem; 'Claim search refinements' (completed) covers filtering, not logging or audit exports; 'Claim information display' (in progress) shows claim overviews; and 'Document classifier confidence threshold' (unstarted) is unrelated. No completed story or roadmap item addresses the inability to log claims or export audit logs, and the core problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
